name: After recital T
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: Ta. whereas China’s ‘Justice Mission 2025’ military exercise resulted in numerous crossings of the median line of the Taiwan Strait by Chinese aircraft, as well as crossings of the median line and repeated attempts to violate Taiwan’s contiguous zone by Chinese ships, and the blocking-off of a large number of maritime areas in an exercise of encircling and blockading Taiwan and its ports, and the conducting of long-range live firing exercises, with missiles landing in Taiwan’s contiguous zone;
